meta.semantics: consumer-side EAX window after each call site in full_export disasm snapshot; straight-line block (truncated at label/jcc/jmp/ret/loop/int and at the next call); window<=12 insns; carrier=eax with copy extension (mov r2,carrier; <=2 tracked regs); vptr-chain continuation keeps the window alive when the last carrier is consumed by an offset-0 deref (mov eax,[eax]; call [eax+N] canonical form).

rules.vdispatch: tracked -> mov r2,[tracked] -> call [r2+N] (or mov r3,[r2+N]; call r3); N byte offset, N%4==0, N>=0x20 (deep only); candidates = classes whose MAIN vtable has slot index N/4 (anchors/vtable_slot_authority.json)
rules.mread: mov/movsx/movzx r3,[tracked+OFF], OFF>=0x40 (deep only, any size prefix); candidates = classes with member at OFF (anchors/member_types.json, C18 offset signature)
rules.vfptr: mov [tracked+O], offset <vtable>, any O; class via ??_7 mangled name (authority .?AV) or off_/dword_ VA (rtti_vtable_class.json); spec verdict: return IN {class} U rtti-descendants (descendants left to consumers)
rules.dd: mov r,[tracked] (offset 0) consumed by cmp/test; emitted only when the same entity has class 1-3 rows; carries no type candidates
